name: DPM-2 Ancestral (VE path)
plain: DPM-2's midpoint step aimed at σ_down, then fresh noise added back up to σ'. Same two model calls per step as DPM-2, plus the ancestral randomness. Non-flow branch; flow models use the RF entry.
math:
Symbols: x current latent; σ=sigmas[i]; σ'=sigmas[i+1]; D=denoised (x0 prediction after CFG); U=uncond_denoised; d=(x−D)/σ. 
get_ancestral_step: σ_up=min(σ', η·√(σ'²(σ²−σ'²)/σ²)); σ_down=√(σ'²−σ_up²); η=0 returns (σ', 0).
σ_m=exp(lerp(log σ, log σ_down, ½)); x₂=x+d(σ_m−σ); D₂ at σ_m; x'=x+d₂(σ_down−σ)+n·s_noise·σ_up.

props.prediction_space: σ with midpoint in log σ
props.final_sigma0: Explicit: σ_down=0 one Euler step, equals D, no noise added.

label: from code
surprise: Also subject to the KSampler penultimate-sigma discard.
